annotations.title: Read an object at a past time

description: Read a Sui object as it was at a version, checkpoint or time: its fields and owner then, or whether it was deleted or wrapped. Use it for what a pool, vault or position looked like before a change. Example: { id: "0x...", time: "2026-10-30T00:00:00Z" }.

checkpoint.description: A checkpoint sequence number, instead of time.

time.description: A past time: ISO 8601 like 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z (UTC), or unix seconds.

name: get_object_at
title: Read an object at a past time
